verse.text: But watch out! Be careful never to forget what you yourself have seen. Do not let these memories escape from your mind as long as you live! And be sure to pass them on to your children and grandchildren.

reflection: Every dad is already teaching his kids something — through the stories he tells, the way he handles stress, and what he treats as sacred. Moses' charge here isn't about giving your kids a perfect record, it's about not letting the moments where God showed up for you slip away unspoken. Tell your kids the story tonight — the answered prayer, the hard lesson, the moment you knew God was real to you — because that's how faith gets handed down, one dinner-table story at a time.
